stops.title: Yu Ɔvavyu
stops.caption: Di fɔs dɔ, ɛn na wetin yu rol kɔva nɔmɔ.
stops.speech: Dis na Kairos. I de opin pan yu ɔvavyu, ɛn ɔltin we yu de si ya na wetin na yu rispɔnsibiliti fɔ tru.

stops.title: Di Saydba
stops.caption: Siks grup. Yu de si di wan dɛn we fɔ yu.
stops.speech: Di saydba grup insay Pipul, Grup dɛn, Gadarin dɛn, Analitiks ɛn Ɔganizeshɔn. Sɛkshɔn we yu nɔ de si na wan we yu rol nɔ nid.

stops.title: Mɛmba dɛn
stops.caption: Ɔlman pan wan lis.
stops.speech: Mɛmba na di dairɛktri. Ɔlman insay di chɔch de ya, wit dɛn om branch ɛn if dɛn dɔn du di mɛmbaship klas.

stops.title: Fɛloship dɛn
stops.caption: Di smɔl grup dɛn, wit map.
stops.speech: Fɛloship dɛn na di smɔl grup dɛn. K-Groups, Kharis Express, New Breeds ɛn di ɔda dɛn, wit map fɔ fɛn di wan we nia yu.

stops.title: Dipatmɛnt dɛn
stops.caption: Ministri tim dɛn ɛn dɛn rota.
stops.speech: Dipatmɛnt dɛn na di ministri tim dɛn. Ɛvri wan kip in yon mɛmba lis, in sav rota ɛn di pipul we de aplay fɔ jɔyn.

stops.title: Atɛndans
stops.caption: Sɛvis, chɛk-in ɛn di rɛjista dɛn.
stops.speech: Atɛndans kɔva sɛvis ɛn chɛk-in. Pipul kin chɛk dɛnsɛf in wit QR kod, ɔ di dɛsk kin rɛkɔd dɛn we dɛn kam.

stops.title: Di Sol Paiplain
stops.caption: Frɔm di fɔs kɔntakt sote go na dipatmɛnt.
stops.speech: Di sol paiplain de fɔlo pɔsin we wi rich tru ɛvanjelizm: nyu, wi de fɔlo ɔp, i want, i kɔnvat, ɛn insay disaypulship.

stops.title: Ripɔt dɛn
stops.caption: Atɛndans, groth ɛn ɛngejmɛnt.
stops.speech: Ripɔt de tɔn ɔl dat to nɔmba. Atɛndans trɛnd, aw mɛmbaship de gro ɛn ɛngejmɛnt, ɔl insay wetin yu rol kɔva.

stops.title: Yu Langwej
stops.caption: Kairos ɛn dis gayd, na fo langwej.
stops.speech: Kairos de tɔk Inglish, Frɛnch, Krio ɛn Twi. Chenj am frɔm di saydba, ɛn di gayd go opin na di sem langwej.
